_comment: v3, written 2026-09-21. v1 and v2 never collected data. Everything EXCEPT the 'api' block is locked from the moment the first `run` writes an event. The 'api' block only controls throughput and may be tuned at any time. One pre-launch exception: if GeckoTerminal's network id for Robinhood Chain is not 'robinhood', correct it before the first run. That is a naming fix, not a design change.

api._note: OPERATIONAL. Tune freely. Affects speed, never what is measured. Spacing is 20s from Claude Code's live measurement (7s: 60% blocked, 15s: 30%, 20s: 10%).

universe._note: Tradeable-universe gate, applied BEFORE the filter, identically to both arms. Pools failing it are 'untradeable' and excluded from scoring.

filter._source: @insentos video 'BEST FILTERS TO TRADE ON ROBINHOOD' (Robinhood Chain). Market-size half of the filter panel only. The safety half is not reproducible from free data on this chain; see preregistration.
